stats.increment: decode GetGameStat, saturate at 0xFFFFFF, encode SetGameStat; out-of-range indices do nothing
stats.ownership: save/meta state; not Battle Factory round state and not exposed by battle-lab manifests. Outside the Factory, Mauville's Storyteller has visible Splash and Struggle story entries at threshold 1.

scripts.recoil: BattleScript_EffectRecoil: setmoveeffect recoil -> jumpifnotmove MOVE_STRUGGLE -> incrementgamestat GAME_STAT_USED_STRUGGLE -> goto BattleScript_EffectHit. Non-Struggle recoil skips the opcode; the shared hit route later owns attackcanceler, attackstring, ppreduce, damage/recoil, messages, and MoveEnd.
scripts.splash: BattleScript_EffectSplash: attackcanceler -> attackstring -> ppreduce -> attackanimation -> waitanimation -> incrementgamestat GAME_STAT_USED_SPLASH -> printstring STRINGID_BUTNOTHINGHAPPENED -> waitmessage -> MoveEnd. PP is therefore deducted before the stat write; the nothing-happened message follows it.

boundedRemainder: The real Scene-OFF carrier receipt establishes normal Splash selection and PP-before-message timing but manifests do not expose gSaveBlock1 gameStats, script PC, or the attacker-side gate. A legal forced-Struggle receipt would require exhausting all four move PP by ROM actions; the public staging contract forbids injecting zero PP or transient state, so that long route is deliberately not manufactured. Source pins both hidden writes, saturation/encryption, all battle-type independence, and opponent-side no-write behavior. Mauville Storyteller is an out-of-round visible consumer at threshold 1; no seven-battle Factory outcome, swap, round counter, battle state, RNG, controller synchronization, or presentation behavior reads these two game stats. A future faithful full-save port should own the optional counters in a save/meta layer invoked after the rules-machine opcode gate, not in facility round state.
